The 2014–2015 Missouri State Lady Bears basketball team represented Missouri State University during the 2014-2015 NCAA Division I women's basketball season. The Lady Bears competed in the Missouri Valley Conference (MVC) and played their home games at the JQH Arena in Springfield, Missouri.

### Coaching Staff
The team was coached by Kellie Harper, who was in her second season as head coach of the Lady Bears during the 2014-15 season. Harper brought a strong basketball background to the program, having previously succeeded as a player under Pat Summitt at Tennessee and as a coach at various other institutions.
